definitions.gloss: wide area, broad region, extensive area
definitions.explanation: A large geographical area or zone. Commonly used in administrative, disaster management, and planning contexts to refer to operations or phenomena spanning multiple localities.

examples.japanese: {広域|こういき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A power outage occurred across a wide area.

examples.japanese: {広域|こういき}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えた→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Conduct training in preparation for a wide-area disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市町村|しちょうそん}→市町村：16065_shichouson⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{広域|こういき}⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: Multiple municipalities are cooperating to tackle wide-area governance.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used primarily in written and official contexts. Frequently appears in news about disasters, public administration, and infrastructure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広域|こういき}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: wide-area disaster
- {広域|こういき}⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧: wide-area investigation
- {広域|こういき}⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧: wide-area administration
- {広域|こういき}⟦ネットワーク→ネットワーク：04759_nettowaaku⟧: wide-area network
- {広域|こういき}⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧: wide-area evacuation
